subject.title: Enhancement: Add Nous Research / Hermes Agent as a provider

question: If Nous publishes the requested supported usage contract and sanitized fixture, should CodexBar accept it as a first-class provider under the existing provider architecture?
rationale: Provider coverage fits VISION.md, but the repository owner explicitly requires sign-off for this unresolved authentication, privacy, and external-contract boundary.

options.title: Approve after contract
options.body: Accept the provider only after a documented endpoint or stable CLI JSON contract proves units, limits, resets, auth scopes, refresh behavior, and a short-lived credential path.

options.title: Keep unsupported
options.body: Decline core support if Nous only exposes private dashboard behavior or requires CodexBar to read long-lived refresh tokens or scrape browser credentials.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract
recommendation.body: Accept the provider only after a documented endpoint or stable CLI JSON contract proves units, limits, resets, auth scopes, refresh behavior, and a short-lived credential path.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the repository owner and already defined the exact acceptance and security criteria for this provider request.
